# E0214: a minor version changes a default

A defaulted field fills with its default when absent. A minor version that
changes the default makes the same absent field mean a different value, which
is a breaking change for every instance that relied on the old one.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				u: *"foo" | "bar" | "baz"
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				u: "foo" | "bar" | *"baz"
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0214]: u in schema v0.1 fills with "baz" when absent, where the prior schema filled it with "foo"
  --> lineage.cue:11:5
   |
11 |                 u: "foo" | "bar" | *"baz"
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema v0.1 is a minor version, so it must accept all data schema v0.0 accepts
   = help: make the change compatible, or make this version v1.0
```
